content: {"rule":"K-S2","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge uses the lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity as the reason to mark the point UNDERDETERMINED, which is the kind of single-verse/link-silence ground K-S2 governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"D6 vs C4 (Romans 1:3): UNDERDETERMINED -- answered in [CR2] section A.1-2 and [CR3] Link 6 premises 1-3, where descent according to the flesh is weighed against conception of the Holy Ghost without explicit textual resolution of paternity.","rule_words":"That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.","room":"Phrase: a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED. Reading 1: this bars only express single-verse-silence reasoning. Reading 2: this also bars an UNDERDETERMINED verdict grounded in lack of explicit textual resolution of paternity when the verse leaves the question open.","why":"The judge’s stated ground for UNDERDETERMINED is the absence of explicit textual resolution of paternity, so it treats the verse’s failure to resolve the link as a reason for UNDERDETERMINED, which K-S2 forbids."}
